episode_summary: In this episode, Frances Katzen shares her insights on the impact of the Pietta Tear Tax on New York's real estate market and the importance of having a strong personal brand. She emphasizes the value of consistency in marketing and how her monthly Katzen Report has been a key tool in building client relationships. Frances also discusses the role of media appearances in establishing credibility and attracting high-profile clients.
